description: Effective permissions of a delegated agent: requested ∩ user ∩ parent, minus explicit denials — Computes what a sub-agent may actually do: the permissions it requested, intersected with what the end user holds and what its parent agent holds, minus any explicit deny list, and says for each denied permission which party lacks it. Permission names are compared exactly (no wildcards); caller-declared implications (for example 'admin' grants 'read') can be given and are expanded transitively wit

denied.description: Explicit denials; they win over any grant.

parent.description: Permissions held by the delegating agent.

user.description: Permissions held by the end user.

name: permission-intersection
